note: A roster of Malazan figures sorted into the ROOT0 specialty classes. Wizards are filed by what their magic DOES (the color system), not by warren. An interpretation — re-sort freely; the registry is the source of truth.

members.name: Mallet
members.specialty: Squad cutter. Denul healing — keeps the company breathing when the warrens go quiet.

members.name: Bluepearl
members.specialty: Bridge Burner mage. Mockra and raw force; the blunt instrument of the squad's magic.

members.name: Spindle
members.specialty: Sapper-mage in the famous hair shirt. Munitions and Mockra — destruction by craft.

members.name: Fiddler
members.specialty: Sapper. No warren — just cussers, sharpers, and nerve. Later Master of the Deck; the moral spine.

members.name: Hedge
members.specialty: Fiddler's partner in munitions. Death didn't retire him — he came back to command the dead Bridge Burners.

members.name: Beak
members.specialty: The savant. Shields and annihilates with the same hand — one candle of impossible genius.

members.name: Tayschrenn
members.specialty: Imperial High Mage. Closest any mortal comes to holding it all; touched by every power.

members.name: Quick Ben
members.specialty: Ben Adaephon Delat. Twelve souls, every warren, the plan inside the plan inside the plan. Purple by right; aristocrat by design.

members.name: Kalam Mekhar
members.specialty: The long knives. Quick Ben's other half. The man you send when it simply must be done.

members.name: Gesler
members.specialty: Heavy infantry, half-immortal after the Stormriders. One half of the eternal bickering act.

members.name: Stormy
members.specialty: Adjunct Stormy. Red-bearded fury and a wail of grief. The other half of the bit — and lethal.

members.name: The Marines
members.specialty: Hellian (drunk), Throatslitter, Deadsmell, and the rest — gallows humor holding the line under fire.

members.name: Cotillion
members.specialty: The Rope. Patron god of assassins. Once the man Dancer. The blade that possessed Apsalar.

members.name: Shadowthrone
members.specialty: Ammanas. The throne of Shadow itself. Once the Emperor Kellanved — Dancer's partner in the long game.

members.name: Dancer
members.specialty: Kellanved's partner and blade. Ascended into Cotillion — so the two names are one knife across time.

members.name: Tehol Beddict
members.specialty: Crashed an empire's economy on purpose, mostly from a rooftop, mostly in a blanket. Genius wearing idiot's clothes.

members.name: Bugg
members.specialty: Tehol's manservant and the engine of the scheme. Secretly Mael, Elder God of the Sea. (Also: undying loyalty.)

members.name: Brys Beddict
members.specialty: Tehol's brother. King's Champion, finest blade in Lether. Honor that does not bend, loyalty that does not break.

members.name: Tehol's Household
members.specialty: The rooftop court — Bugg and the crew — loyal to the last absurd, world-saving scheme.

members.name: Apsalar
members.specialty: Once 'Sorry,' a Bridge Burner; possessed by Cotillion into a peerless assassin. Now her own avatar. See: the apsalar repo.

members.name: Karsa Orlong
members.specialty: Toblakai. 'Witness.' He will not look away, and he demands that you do not either. The one who stands and sees.
